decisions.reason: Requesting additional blog-topic suggestions does not change the existing client-proposed keyword selection.
The request for additional topic suggestions does not change the required article type, trial inclusion, or article count.
The source concerns blog-topic ideation and does not alter the SEO plan's deliverable, service-area limits, or treatment of additional work points.
The request for more blog-topic suggestions does not modify the keyword report's keyword count, search-volume requirement, or replacement keywords.
